svg.title: LIN RX Demo - Full Sequence From main() To USART2/LIN Bus

g.text: LIN RX Demo - Full Sequence From main() To USART2/LIN Bus
Initialize USART2 for Rx/Tx LIN Mode
For Rx slots, LinIf directly requests
reception from MCAL without pulling from COM
to discard echo of BREAK, SYNC, PID
App reads latest values from COM
